name: Bilt rewards map social card by bilt.com
description: A portrait-format social card on a near-black navy canvas overlaid with a dimmed city street grid, so the map reads as texture rather than content. Four floating pill cards act as map annotations: three dark glass toasts with gold reward lines, plus one inverted pale-blue card ('You pay rent +2500 pts') that breaks the pattern and carries the focal message, each anchored by a tiny white dot. A two-tone grotesque headline anchors the lower-left — the first sentence in white, the remainder receding to slate blue — so hierarchy flows from the bright card down to the quiet type.
